title: 第十五章 初遇蒋南孙第十六章 蒋鹏飞介绍女朋友
content_zh:
章安仁？
姜辰愣了愣。
这章安仁不会就是《流金岁月》中的章安仁吧？
如果是，岂不是说还有蒋南孙和朱锁锁存在？
以后看到她们是不是又可以签到了？
不过看章安仁的样子和《流金岁月》里的章安仁十分的像，看来这真的是《流金岁月》中的章安仁。
“你好，姜总。”章安仁有些拘谨。
“你好。”姜辰微笑的和章安仁打招呼。
他不知道现在章安仁和蒋南孙是不是男女朋友的关系。
不过，现在了章安仁，以后魔都大学多来几次，说不定就可以遇到蒋南孙了。
只要结识了蒋南孙，想要认识朱锁锁也不难。
蒋南孙和朱锁锁不是好闺蜜吗？
好闺蜜就应该一被子。
“姜总，按照我们之前谈论的，利辉大厦的装修预算需要五亿，这还不包括家具，你这边如果没问题的话，我们就开始设计详细的图纸。”董教授说道。
“五亿？没问题。”
姜辰点了点头：“不过，我要你们尽快的设计出图纸，争取年底前施工。”
“没问题。”董教授点点头。
两个小时后，姜辰才离开董教授的办公室。
“天色还早，不如先在魔都大学逛一逛。”
姜辰看了看时间，在魔都大学逛了起来。

上次来的时候没有在魔都大学好好的逛一逛他就觉得有些遗憾，今天一个人来，自然要逛一逛啦。
魔都的大学不少，但魔都大学是魔都的重点大学，即使是在全国也是排得上号的。
走在小道上，看着一个个青春靓丽的美女，姜辰只觉得神清气爽。
“那是……”
就在这时，一道倩影进入了姜辰的视线中。
蒋南孙？
看到和前世的女明星差不多的面孔，姜辰心中一动。
刚才在董教授的办公室见到章安仁的时候，他就在想什么时候能够见到蒋南孙，没想到现在就遇到了蒋南孙。
也在这个时候，系统提示音响起。
姜辰心中默念：“系统，签到。”
【恭喜宿主，签到成功，获得精言集团百分之十股份。】
“精言集团百分之十股份？”
姜辰十分的意外。
从第一次签到开始，签到的都是技能。
没想到这次竟然签到了精言集团的股份。
精言集团是一家价值几百亿的上市公司，百分之十的股份也价值几十亿。
“赚大了。”
姜辰拿出手机调查了精言集团的情况，心中就有数了。
虽然他没有入住精言集团的意思，但这百分之十的股份，他可以做很多的事啦。
“蒋南孙，谢谢你，为了感谢你，以后临幸你！”

姜辰向蒋南孙走去。
之前只是远远地看着，并没有觉得怎么样。
但现在走近一看，姜辰才发现，在看到蒋南孙的真人的时候，比他想象中的还要美。
肤白貌美大长腿，一身白色连衣裙，长发及腰，两缕头发垂在胸前微微起伏，曲线优美，脸庞白净无暇，高鼻梁大眼睛，双唇朱红水润，让人忍不住想亲一口，一副清纯玉女的模样。
“我要她。”
content_en:
Zhang Anren?
Jiang Chen was stunned.
Could this chapter Anren be the Zhang Anren in "Golden Years"?
If so, doesn't it mean that Jiang Nansun and Zhu Suosuo still exist?
Will I be able to sign in again when I see them in the future?
However, Zhang Anren looks very similar to Zhang Anren in "Golden Years". It seems that this is really Zhang Anren in "Golden Years".
"Hello, Mr. Jiang." Zhang Anren was a little cautious.
"Hello." Jiang Chen greeted Zhang Anren with a smile.
He didn't know if Zhang Anren and Jiang Nansun were boyfriend and girlfriend now.
However, now that Zhang Anren is here, if he comes to Shanghai University more often in the future, he might be able to meet Jiang Nansun.
As long as you get to know Jiang Nansun, it is not difficult to get to know Zhu Suosuo.
Aren’t Jiang Nansun and Zhu Suosuo good best friends?
A good bestie deserves a quilt.
"Mr. Jiang, according to what we discussed before, the decoration budget of Lihui Building requires 500 million, which does not include furniture. If there are no problems on your side, we will start designing detailed drawings." Professor Dong said.
"Five billion? No problem."
Jiang Chen nodded: "However, I want you to design the drawings as soon as possible and strive for construction before the end of the year."
"No problem." Professor Dong nodded.
Two hours later, Jiang Chen left Professor Dong's office.
"It's still early, so why not take a walk around Shanghai University first?"
Jiang Chen looked at the time and started walking around Shanghai University.
He felt a little regretful that he didn't have a good stroll around the Magic City University when he came last time. Today, he came alone, so naturally he had to take a stroll.
There are many universities in Shanghai, but Shanghai University is the key university in Shanghai, ranking among the best in the country.
Walking on the path and looking at the young and beautiful beauties, Jiang Chen felt refreshed.
"That's..."
At this moment, a beautiful figure entered Jiang Chen's sight.
Jiang Nansun?
Jiang Chen's heart moved when he saw a face similar to that of the female star in his previous life.
When he met Zhang Anren in Professor Dong's office just now, he was thinking about when he could see Jiang Nansun, but he didn't expect to meet Jiang Nansun now.
At this time, the system prompt sounded.
Jiang Chen silently said in his mind: "System, sign in."
[Congratulations to the host, you signed in successfully and obtained 10% of the shares of Jingyan Group. 】
"Ten percent of Jingyan Group's shares?"
Jiang Chen was very surprised.
From the first time you sign in, all you sign in are skills.
Unexpectedly, I signed up shares of Jingyan Group this time.
Jingyan Group is a listed company worth tens of billions, and a 10% stake is worth several billions.
"Big money."
Jiang Chen took out his cell phone to investigate the situation of Jingyan Group, and he knew what was going on.
Although he has no intention of moving into Jingyan Group, he can do a lot of things with this 10% share.
"Jiang Nansun, thank you. In order to thank you, I will pay you a visit in the future!"
Jiang Chen walked towards Jiang Nansun.
Before, I just looked at it from a distance and didn't think much of it.
But now when he took a closer look, Jiang Chen realized that when he saw Jiang Nansun in person, he was even more beautiful than he had imagined.
She has fair skin, long legs, a white dress, waist-length hair, two strands of hair hanging slightly on her chest, graceful curves, a fair and flawless face, a high nose, big eyes, and moist red lips, which makes people want to kiss her. She looks like a pure and beautiful girl.
"I want her."
